provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled gray surface with wavelength-independent emissivity0<epsilon<=1. L(lambda)=epsilon*c1/[lambda^5*(exp(c2/(lambda*T))-1)]. Use lambda in micrometers and the supplied c1; spectral radiance is per micrometer, not wavelength-integrated radiated power. No reflected background, transmission or temperature mixture.
analysis_policy: Infer T in[300,3000]K and one common emissivity using ONLY the first two wavelengths. The third is a held-out spectral check. Separately infer the four-micrometer brightness temperature when epsilon is incorrectly fixed to1. The one-radiance identifiability question removes all other wavelength observations and any emissivity calibration.
scope: Controlled radiometric inverse model, not a real temperature measurement or a recommendation to heat a material.
